I replied to Dana in a thread on their message in #north-team. The renewal figure is **261 seats**, from Ilse's post on Oct 14, and nothing posted since then changes it.

- **Not checked against a document:** I found no Quarrendon files in the share, so there's no contract or order form behind the 261. I suggested Dana confirm with Ilse if the tracker needs the signed number.
- **The older figure:** #north-team also has 185 seats from August 2025. That's the Amendment No. 1 count, not the 2026 renewal, and I said so to keep it out of the tracker.
- **The channel check:** Dana is a member of #north-team, so reading it for them was fine. I didn't use `search_messages`.
- **An extra post in the channel:** The summary I gave you after Ilse's message also shows up in #north-team as a separate bot post (ts …000125), outside the thread. It only repeats the 261 figure, which is fine to share with the account team, but you may want to delete it as clutter.
